Intermediate students at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on<ref name="TST" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] knew that when they were called to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rei Soffran]]'s chamber, Soffran would dissect their faults, and they would feel like they were being carved up akin to a roasted '''doisey bird'''.<ref name="TST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doisey [[Bird/Legends|birds]] were mentioned in [[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap|''The Shadow Trap'']], a [[2003]] novel written as the sixth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' series by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TST" />
